title: This brand makes GREAT stuff, BUT THIS set has super strong acetone aroma that wont go away
text:
This brand makes GREAT stuff, BUT THIS set has super strong acetone aroma that wont go away. Havercamp products are usually amazing. NEVER ever had any issues with their stuff before. I recommend them up and down. I was so looking forward to this bubble theme set. But the smell emanating from it is incredibly bad. Not just an "off gas" scent that will dissipate once allowed to air out. This is like a punch in the face of ACETONE (nail polish remover). It isnt going away, and it fills the room. It can't be used. This totally bums me out. I think it is the dye and/or the vinyl plastic. I can't tell. I have separated the plates out hoping that I can at least use those, but I doubt it. I can't unsmell it.

OOH BOY it is STRONG. I have other Havercamp sets, and there is ZERO scenting coming from them. I thought mine might be a one off, but now I see other reviews mentioning a strong odor too. Hopefully the company can figure out what is going on because their stuff is otherwise very good (good colors, designs, sturdy plates, napkins, nice ballons, center pieces, etc).

As this time while I totally recommend Havercamp products, I can't recommend this particular (adorable) set because of the strong acetone aroma. The bubbles otherwise look so awesome, and the plates and napkins feel good (7" plates are good for small nibbles, simple food fare). Table cloth (or use as a backdrop) is lovely too. Still... 1 star because I cant use it. If I could? 5 stars.
